ux_findings.canPublishDraft_is_presentation_only: CONFIRMED. `web/src/app-shell/nav-config.js` canPublishDraft(navSet) (lines 261-279) is a pure function reading only the CACHED NavCapabilitySet (getNavCapabilities(), resolved once at boot, T-0539) — no fetch, no side effect, returns a boolean consumed ONLY as screen-app-records.jsx's `canPublish` prop, which gates (a) which banner sentence renders and (b) whether the «Опубликовать» button renders at all. It is never sent to the server, never read by any authz check. Verified server-side: PublishSolutionDialog's actual publish action (apps-publish-dialog.jsx -> apps-publish-api.js -> POST /api/applications/:id/publish-solution) has its own independent, unchanged server-side authz — the dialog itself does no client-side role gating (an unauthorized caller reaching it would simply get a non-2xx POST response surfaced as an error toast, not a client-side block). Fail-closed: null/degraded NavCapabilitySet -> canPublishDraft returns false (no button shown), never worse than omitting the affordance.

ux_findings.honest_404: CONFIRMED. screen-record-detail.jsx's notFoundAppIsDraft best-effort check (lines 623-677) fetches GET /api/applications/:appId ONLY after a 404 from GET /api/records/:id, swallows any failure (network error / app already published / missing appId) and leaves the flag false, in which case the EmptyState renders the EXACT prior generic copy 'Запись не найдена или у вас нет к ней доступа.' byte-identical to pre-task. The draft-branch copy ('если это запись коллеги, она станет видна после публикации приложения владельцем') is deliberately non-committal — true under both 'record exists but hidden' and 'record never existed', matching the server's own intentional non-disclosure (T-0558). The underlying GET /api/records/:id 404 contract is untouched; this is copy layered on the client after the fact, not a new server signal. Verified server-side that GET /api/applications/:id (src/http/applications.ts ~lines 629-648) applies no privilege/tier filter beyond tenant-scoping (RLS) — any tenant member already gets 200+tier for any app id in their tenant via this route today (same as the /apps list), so reusing it here opens no new surface.
